seoTitle: EAA and EN 301 549 Web Content Checklist (Clause 9 Summary)
metaDescription: Mark each EN 301 549 clause 9 web requirement (WCAG 2.1 A and AA) as met, partial, not met or n/a and get a readiness summary.
intro: Summarises your status for each EN 301 549 clause 9 web requirement.
why:
The European Accessibility Act points to EN 301 549, whose web clause mirrors WCAG 2.1 A and AA.

Paste a status per clause and get counts, a table by principle and the open items. You can also print a blank checklist. It covers web content only, not documents, software or functional performance. The mapping was derived from the WCAG text and prior knowledge of EN 301 549 V3.2.1; the standard was not available to check.
howTo: Choose the blank checklist to copy it.
Add met, partial, not or na after each clause.
Switch to the summary and paste your lines.

faq.a: No. It records your own judgement.

faq.q: Does the EAA apply to me?
faq.a: That depends on your products and services; ask a legal adviser.
